Free countdown timer

Set a time, press start and put it on the board. Big, clear digits, a chime when the time is up, and nothing to sign up for.

Open full screenChange the times, sound and look

How to use the countdown timer

  1. The timer starts at 10 minutes. Use the minus and plus buttons to change it, or choose another length in the timer settings.
  2. Press Start. Pause and carry on whenever you need to.
  3. The digits change colour in the last few minutes, and a chime sounds when the time is up.

Press Full screen to fill the board or projector. In the settings you can also choose an analogue clock face, your own colours and fonts, and a title such as “Group work” or “Tidy up”.

Made for classrooms

A visible countdown helps learners pace themselves: for a test section, a group task, a debate turn or the last minutes before the bell. The numbers are large enough to read from the back of a hall, and the timer keeps going if the page is refreshed by accident.

Questions

Is the countdown timer free?

Yes. It is free, needs no account and has nothing to install. It works in any modern browser.

Can I make it full screen?

Yes. Press Full screen in the toolbar. The toolbar hides itself when the mouse is still, so only the time shows.

Does it make a sound when the time is up?

Yes, a chime sounds when the countdown ends. You can choose the sound and its volume, or turn it off, in the settings.

Can I share a timer with another teacher?

Yes. Every timer has its own link with all its settings in it. Copy the link from the address bar and anyone who opens it gets the same timer.
